bootstrap.unit: paired items resampled within every frozen joint stratum for rank statistics; paired items across the corpus for aggregates

category_only.role: descriptive robustness view; does not replace the registered joint-stratum analysis

source_only.role: descriptive robustness view; does not replace the registered joint-stratum analysis

computes: Acc_final(step_0) per arm (corpus, strata, descriptive views)
partial_mode.reason: step-100 evaluations are not provided; this output is a plumbing readout of the step-0 side only and is not the registered R3 result

pooling_discipline: Pooled-only readout is prohibited; corpus aggregate, every joint stratum, and source-only/category-only descriptive tables are all published; A2/A2b/A3 are never pooled into one generic blind arm (docs/registered_extensions_v1.md Extension 3, docs/registered_m7_amendment_v1.md).

bootstrap.stream_mechanism: deterministic statistic/arm labels hashed into independent streams via src.analysis.pilot_fourarm.deterministic_seed

provenance.split_manifest_v2_note: data/virl39k_m7_split_manifest_v2.json n_strata_rank_eligible=21 counts component labels, not items, and was not used; eligibility was recounted directly from the held-out jsonl

seed_scope.between_seed_dispersion: unmeasured: seed 1 only; seed 2 deferred, not abandoned (docs/registered_m7_seed_scope_v1.md)
seed_scope.statement: Seed scope: seed 1 only for all four arms; every gain, recovery, and correlation below is a per-seed (one seed) number and no between-seed variance claim is made (docs/registered_m7_seed_scope_v1.md).

single_image_restriction.statement: Single-image restriction: M7 is restricted to single-image rows (worker.rollout.limit_images=1); retained 23,542/25,255 train rows (93.2%) and 4,239/4,501 held-out rows (94.2%) (docs/registered_m7_single_image_v2.md).
